answer: Each agent identity must run its own verifiable data-oracle feed, publishing fresh readings that peers check against ground truth. A raven carries only its own ridge's report to the summit, and a copied feed betrays itself when its reef of readings mirrors another's. Accuracy accrues slowly to one feed alone, so fielding a hundred fakes means sourcing and maintaining a hundred accurate live feeds in real time — a cost paid per identity that cannot be shared or amortized across clones.
